title: Personal Loan Eligibility for Rs 25,000 Salary | Example
metaDescription: See an illustrative personal-loan eligibility example for Rs 25,000 monthly take-home pay using 50% FOIR, no existing EMI, 14% rate and 48 months.
h1: Personal Loan Eligibility for Rs 25,000 Monthly Salary
quickAnswer: With Rs 25,000 monthly take-home pay, no existing EMI, a 50% FOIR assumption, 14% annual rate and 48-month tenure, the existing RupeeKit calculator illustration supports about Rs 4.57 lakh of borrowing capacity. This is an educational estimate, not approval or a lender offer.
evidence: Issue #84 cites salary-band GSC demand including Rs 25k; issue #75 and the live calculator content also record the same salary-band intent and assumptions.

title: Rs 10 Lakh Personal Loan EMI for 5 Years | 14% Example
metaDescription: See the EMI for an illustrative Rs 10 lakh personal loan at 14% for 60 months, then open the RupeeKit calculator with the same inputs to compare scenarios.
h1: Rs 10 Lakh Personal Loan EMI for 5 Years at 14%
quickAnswer: For an illustrative Rs 10 lakh personal loan at 14% annual interest over 60 months, the standard reducing-balance formula gives an EMI of about Rs 23,268 per month, before processing fees or optional add-on costs. This is a scenario, not a live lender quote.
assumptions: Processing fees, GST on fees and optional add-ons are not included in the headline EMI
evidence: Issue #84 explicitly cites the GSC query shape 'EMI for 10 lakh personal loan'; the live calculator already includes a Rs 10 lakh / 5 year / 14% preset.
